{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient_id
df_grouped = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(df_grouped[df_grouped > 1])}')

# Confirm that higher sample_seq is more recent (by logic of re-testing)
print(f'Max sample_seq value: {df["sample_seq"].max()}')"}
